## 일일 전쟁사

- **1177** — Baldwin IV of Jerusalem and Raynald of Châtillon defeat Saladin at the Battle of Montgisard. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baldwin_IV_of_Jerusalem))
- **1491** — The siege of Granada, the last Moorish stronghold in Spain, ends with the Treaty of Granada. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada_War))
- **1596** — The Cudgel War begins in Finland (at the time part of Sweden), when peasants rebel against the imposition of taxes by the nobility. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cudgel_War))
- **1678** — Trunajaya rebellion: After a long and logistically challenging march, the allied Mataram and Dutch troops successfully assault the rebel stronghold of Kediri. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trunajaya_rebellion))
- **1758** — French and Indian War: British forces capture Fort Duquesne from French control. Later, Fort Pitt will be built nearby and grow into modern Pittsburgh. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_and_Indian_War))
- **1783** — American Revolutionary War: The last British troops leave New York City, three months after the signing of the Treaty of Paris. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Revolutionary_War))
